summary: Contestants demonstrate foundational knowledge of network administration in a Cisco environment by configuring, managing, and securing network devices and architectures. The event includes an objective test, and at Nationals, a certification exam and a performance component. Contestants may use reference materials for some portions, but not for certification testing.
time_limits: Preliminaries - No more than sixty (60) minutes for objective test

Preliminaries (Nationals only) - No more than sixty (60) minutes for objective test, no more than fifty (50) minutes for certification test, and no more than sixty (60) minutes for performance component
Finals (Nationals only) - No more than sixty (60) minutes for performance component
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials, including hands-on tasks
competencies: Design, configure, secure, and optimize routing, switching, VLANs, and First Hop Redundancy Protocols (FHRP) to ensure efficient, segmented, and highly available enterprise networks
Design and implement scalable LAN/WAN topologies using advanced routing, switching, and security protocols to support resilient and secure network infrastructures
Configure and manage NAT, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, and access control lists (ACLs) to secure and control network traffic in modern environments
Implement network management solutions to monitor, analyze, and maintain network health, performance, and security
Explain the fundamentals of Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and how centralized control, programmability, and abstraction improve network flexibility, automation, and security
Use network automation tools to streamline configuration, reduce errors, and improve efficiency in managing network devices and services
Configure wireless LAN controllers (WLCs) to manage access points, apply wireless policies, and ensure secure, scalable, and high-performance wireless network operations
Plan and deploy wireless access points by analyzing coverage needs, interference, capacity requirements, and best-practice placement to support reliable and efficient wireless connectivity
judging_notes: Previous Business Professionals of America tests and/or sample tests (handwritten, photocopied or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
Reference materials are not allowed for certification testing
Scores from the preliminary round and the objective test will not carry over to the finals
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this objective event.
